messages:
rachel: Quick sync: PM wants a small, deterministic preview for routing-policy audit exports. Key asks: representative sampling, clear quota estimate, and per-field sensitivity reasons in the preview.

bobby: Proposal: bucket by actor_role + change_type + time-window and pick top-k per bucket. That gives coverage instead of just latest N.

ayan: Agree. Make sampler deterministic by seeding with (query_hash, time_range, preview_id) so preview aligns with final export seed. Store seed in job metadata.

tori: UX: slide-over with ~15 rows, each row shows similarity_count, sensitive_badges, and a redaction toggle. Default masked for PII; users with export permission can reveal.

rachel: API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports/preview {query, buckets, per_bucket} -> {preview_id, samples_ndjson, estimated_credits}. Then POST /v1/audit/exports/commit {preview_id, redaction_policy} -> job_id.

bobby: Implementation note: preview payload max size 100KB. If estimated preview > limit, return 413 with suggestion to narrow range or increase bucketing.

ayan: Security: preview rows must include redactable_fields and sensitivity_reasons (PII/credential/ip). Any revealed values require explicit admin opt-in and an audit event for the reveal.

tori: Telemetry: emit export.preview.shown, export.preview.revealed_count, export.commit.estimated_credits. That will help tune preview pricing.

rachel: Presigned link TTL: default 1h. For privileged exports shorten to 15m. Also record export.manifest (manifest_v1) with bundle_hash and signer_key_id; sign in next sprint if we can't ship it now.

bobby: UX decision: no inline edits for rollout one. Toggle keep/remove + reason select. Simpler legal review.

infra-bot: ci/preview-sampler job started by bobby (#1122)

ayan: Action items: bobby -> prototype deterministic bucket sampler, tori -> mock slide-over, security -> doc for reveal audit. Aim: prototype by EOW.

rachel: Great. I'll write a one-pager and tag legal. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
